SECTION 01 / SERVICES
WHAT WE ENGINEER

Six systems. One retrofit strategy.

Every project starts with what the structure actually needs — not a default technique. These are the core systems we design and execute with.

SYSTEM 01

Seismic retrofitting

Strengthening framing, connections, and load paths so a structure meets current seismic code requirements for earthquake-prone zones.

SYSTEM 02

FRP strengthening

Carbon and glass fibre-reinforced polymer wraps that add flexural and shear capacity to columns, beams, and slabs without adding significant dead weight.

SYSTEM 03

Column & beam jacketing

Encasing weakened structural members in reinforced concrete or steel jackets to restore and increase their original load-bearing capacity.

SYSTEM 04

Structural health assessment

Non-destructive testing, load rating, and condition surveys that tell you exactly what a structure can, and can't, safely carry today.

SYSTEM 05

Crack repair & grouting

Epoxy and polymer-modified injection grouting that seals structural cracks and restores monolithic, load-sharing behaviour.

SYSTEM 06

Waterproofing & coatings

Membrane and protective coating systems that stop water ingress and corrosion before they turn into structural problems.

HOW A PROJECT MOVES

From site survey to signed-off structure.

We run every retrofit like a drawing set — each stage reviewed and revised before the next one starts.

STEP 1

Assessment

Site survey, non-destructive testing, and load calculations, summarised in a written condition report before any technique is proposed.

STEP 2

Design

A retrofit scheme engineered to meet the relevant IS code and your project's specific load and occupancy requirements.

STEP 3

Execution

Trained crews carry out the retrofit on-site, with material test certificates recorded at every stage of the work.

STEP 4

Sign-off

Final structural certification and as-built documentation handed over, so the record travels with the building.

OUR APPROACH

Why an engineered retrofit, not a guess.

  • Assessment before recommendationNo technique gets proposed until we've measured what the structure actually needs.
  • Code compliant designEvery retrofit scheme is engineered against the applicable Indian Standard, not a generic template.
  • Material test certificatesFRP, grout, and coating batches are logged and certified as work progresses, not after the fact.
  • One point of accountabilityThe team that surveys your structure is the same team that signs off on the finished retrofit.
